sourcedFrom: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 (2018)
cleanIntro: A Maverick 91 is a tube-fed pump whose barrel is held by a MAGAZINE CAP — not the 88's take-down screw — and that one difference is why it has its own row. The cap sits in front of a magazine spring retainer under significant pressure, so it is the part to respect. Unloading runs through the cartridge stop, one shell at a time, with the gun inverted.

steps.title: Safety fully RIGHT to ON, nothing on the trigger
steps.action: Move the crossbolt safety fully to the right to ON and keep the muzzle somewhere harmless. Nothing touches the trigger for the whole unload.
steps.quote: Move the safety button (Fig. 2), fully to the right, to the “ON” (SAFE) position. During unloading, never allow ﬁngers or any object to contact the trigger.
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — UNLOADING

steps.title: Chambered round out first — slowly, by hand
steps.action: Depress the action lock lever and draw the forearm back SLOWLY until the live shell is fully withdrawn and visible in the ejection port, then lift it out by hand. Racking hard throws a live round across the room.
steps.quote: Depress the action lock lever (Fig. 3) and pull the forearm rearward, slowly, until the live shotshell is completely withdrawn and visible in the ejection port. Remove shotshell by hand.
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — UNLOADING

steps.title: Next shell onto the elevator, then tip it out
steps.action: Keep pulling the forearm back to release the next shell onto the elevator, turn the gun so the ejection port faces down and let it fall clear. Then close the action on an empty chamber.
steps.quote: Turn the shotgun so that the ejection port faces downward to allow the released shotshell to drop out through the ejection port.
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — UNLOADING

steps.title: ⛔ Tube emptied through the cartridge stop
steps.action: Turn the gun trigger-guard-up, put a thumb into the opening in the bottom of the receiver and depress the cartridge stop on the right side. One shell releases each time; repeat until the tube is empty. A tube that looks empty from the muzzle rarely is.
steps.quote: Insert your right thumb into the opening in the bottom of the receiver and depress the cartridge stop on the right side to release shotshells one at a time (Fig. 9).
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — UNLOADING

steps.title: Safety ON, all three places checked, glasses on
steps.action: Before a part moves: safety ON, and chamber, elevator and magazine checked by eye and by finger.
steps.quote: Position the safety button in the “ON” (SAFE) position and visually and physically check chamber, elevator and magazine to be certain the shotgun is unloaded. Wear eye protection during disassembly and cleaning.
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — DISASSEMBLY / BARREL REMOVAL

steps.title: Bolt to the middle of the ejection port
steps.action: Depress the action lock lever, run the forearm fully back, then walk it slowly forward until the front of the bolt sits mid-port. That is where the barrel releases without fighting the action.
steps.quote: Move the forearm slowly forward from the fully rearward position until the front of the bolt is in the middle of the ejection port (Fig. 7).
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — DISASSEMBLY / BARREL REMOVAL

steps.title: ⛔ MAGAZINE CAP — and the spring behind it is under real pressure
steps.action: Turn the 91's magazine cap counterclockwise until its threads are completely off the end of the magazine tube. ⛔ This is the 91's retention, not the 88's take-down screw. The magazine spring retainer and spring behind it are under significant pressure — keep a hand over the cap as the last threads come free and do not let it leave under its own power.
steps.quote: The 91™ Model magazine spring retainer and spring are under signiﬁcant spring pressure.
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — DISASSEMBLY / BARREL REMOVAL

steps.title: Barrel out with a rocking pull
steps.action: Work the barrel back and forth in small rotations while drawing it forward out of the receiver.
steps.quote: Remove the barrel from the receiver with a gentle back-and-forth rotational movement while pulling the barrel out of the receiver assembly.
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — DISASSEMBLY / BARREL REMOVAL

steps.title: Trigger housing pin — 3/16", then lift the rear first
steps.action: Trigger guard upward, push out the small trigger housing retainer pin with a blunt object no greater than 3/16", about half an inch below the rear of the trigger guard. Then lift the REAR of the housing first and take it out.
steps.quote: Remove the trigger housing assembly by lifting the rear portion upward ﬁrst.
steps.cite: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual — Part No. 67652, typeset 3/8/18 — TRIGGER HOUSING REMOVAL

deepAbsentReason: The Maverick book stops the owner at the trigger housing, which it declares complex and not to be disassembled. ⛔ No deeper path is invented for it.

cleaning.name: BARREL AND CHAMBER
tasks: Solvent and brush through bore and chamber, patches until clean
Wipe the barrel extension and its seat in the receiver
cleaning.quote: Wear eye protection during disassembly and cleaning.
cleaning.src: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual, DISASSEMBLY / BARREL REMOVAL

cleaning.name: ACTION AND RECEIVER
tasks: Bolt, slide and action bars free of residue
⛔ The magazine tube outside only — leave the spring and retainer alone unless removal is genuinely necessary
cleaning.quote: Use caution should removal be necessary to prevent injury to yourself or others around you.
cleaning.src: 88™ AND 91™ MODEL PUMP ACTION SHOTGUNS — Maverick owner's manual, DISASSEMBLY / BARREL REMOVAL

reassembly: Safety ON. Trigger housing in, front first, rear settled down, pin flush.
Barrel into the receiver with the same rocking motion.
⛔ Magazine cap on clockwise against spring pressure, finger tight only.
Action cycled several times to feel it run free.
Function test before it is put away.
fncheck: Safety fully right to ON, chamber elevator and tube proven empty. Depress the action lock lever and cycle the action several times for free travel. Closed and on SAFE, pull the trigger: no hammer fall. Safety off, finger clear: no fall on its own; then the trigger drops it. ⛔ Check the magazine cap is fully seated — on a 91 it is holding a spring, not just a barrel.
